Enzan's Brother#000.src: Well, I'd best get back to my business. It was nice talking to you, traveler. Come around anytime.

Enzan's Brother#001.src: Business is a touch slow today, but feel free to have a seat. Would you like a {p} Whiskey? On the house.

Enzan's Brother#002.src: You can even take your pals along with you for free if you're in a party!

Enzan's Brother#003.src: You've joined that mission of theirs then, have you? Good luck. From what parts I overheard, it'll be quite treacherous.

Enzan's Brother#005.src: He just got back. You can't... tell him now. You'll do it later, once he's settled in.

Enzan's Brother#006.src: Welcome to the V.S.S. Seaskipper, from Seasail Enterprises! There's nothin' better than Seasail if you're lookin' to travel!

Enzan's Brother#007.src: Just hop on the boat and buy a pass so you can get goin' to almost anywhere on the ocean!

Enzan's Brother#008.src: Talk to Enzan close to the exit of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Enzan's Brother#009.src: I see you want to venture into the wilderness!
Enzan's Brother#009.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#010.src: My name is Enzan, and I am now a retired knight. I've spent most of my life fighting for {p}'s army, just like you.
Enzan's Brother#010.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#011.src: I know how hard it must be to be a recruit at this time, so I've got something that could help you! Well, I don't have it, but my brother does!
Enzan's Brother#011.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#012.src: Follow this road, he's just past the item identifier, you can't miss him. Just head to the big set of stairs, past the item identifier.
Enzan's Brother#012.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#013.src: Tell him I sent you! He can be such a jerk to strangers sometimes, especially when he's focused on his stairs...
Enzan's Brother#013.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#014.src: Find Enzan's brother near the Item Identifier on the {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Enzan's Brother#015.src: Excuse me? Can't you see I'm busy?
Enzan's Brother#015.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#016.src: Oh, my brother? Sorry, I didn't know.
Enzan's Brother#016.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#017.src: Why yes, I actually have something that could help you...
Enzan's Brother#017.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#018.src: But before I give it to you, why don't you help me with something first?
Enzan's Brother#018.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#019.src: You see, there's a special kind of mushroom that grows in this cave. I hear it has certain... energizing properties.
Enzan's Brother#019.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#020.src: If you can bring me [{~} Energy Mushroom], I'll help you out. Enter the cave down the stairs, and bring me that mushroom!
Enzan's Brother#020.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#021.src: Descend into the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring [{~} Energy Mushroom] to Therck

Enzan's Brother#022.src: Ah, you're back! Do you have the mushroom?
Enzan's Brother#022.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#023.src: Take this ring. It's an accessory item! You can identify it at the nearby Item Identifier.
Enzan's Brother#023.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#024.src: It's a very good ring for someone starting out like you. There's just one small issue...
Enzan's Brother#024.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#025.src: To wear it, you must help my friend back in {p}. He's been pestering me for days about needing help.
Enzan's Brother#025.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#026.src: You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger. Well, see you around, {u} .

Enzan's Brother#027.src: Ah, you're back. Do you have the mushroom?

Enzan's Brother#028.src: Excellent... Now I might finally be able to climb these stairs...

Enzan's Brother#029.src: Who knows, maybe there's a treasure or something up there?

Enzan's Brother#030.src: Take this ring. It's an accessory item. You can identify it at the nearby Item Identifier.
